name: sendWidget

parameters.name: chat_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target supergroup in the format @username

parameters.name: message_thread_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the target message thread (topic) of a forum; for forum supergroups and private chats of bots with forum topic mode enabled only

parameters.name: html
parameters.description: HTML code of the widget, 1-32768 bytes. The code must not exceed 4096 bytes when compressed by zlib with the maximum compression level.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width of the widget in logical pixels; omit if the widget must occupy the whole width of the message bubble. The width is clamped by the app to the range from 200 to the maximum width of the message bubble.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Height of the widget in logical pixels; omit if the height of the widget isn't fixed. The height is clamped by the app to the range 50-600.

parameters.name: public_data
parameters.description: Public data of the widget, 0-1024 bytes, which will be available wherever the widget is shown. If the widget is shared, then all messages with it will have the same public data.

parameters.name: chat_data
parameters.description: Data of the widget, which is specific to the message, 0-1024 bytes

parameters.name: caption
parameters.description: Widget caption, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing

parameters.name: parse_mode
parameters.description: Mode for parsing entities in the widget caption. See formatting options for more details.

parameters.name: caption_entities
parameters.description: A JSON-serialized list of special entities that appear in the caption, which can be specified instead of parse_mode

parameters.name: show_caption_above_media
parameters.description: Pass True if the caption must be shown above the widget

parameters.name: allow_queries
parameters.description: Pass True to allow the widget to send queries to the bot

parameters.name: is_shared
parameters.description: Pass True to create a shared widget, which can be sent again using the method sendSharedWidget

parameters.name: disable_notification
parameters.description: Sends the message silently. Users will receive a notification with no sound.

parameters.name: protect_content
parameters.description: Protects the contents of the sent message from forwarding and saving

parameters.name: allow_paid_broadcast
parameters.description: Pass True to allow up to 1000 messages per second, ignoring broadcasting limits for a fee of 0.1 Telegram Stars per message. The relevant Stars will be withdrawn from the bot's balance.

parameters.name: message_effect_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the message effect to be added to the message; for private chats only

parameters.name: reply_parameters
parameters.description: Description of the message to reply to

parameters.name: reply_markup
parameters.type: InlineKeyboardMarkup or ReplyKeyboardMarkup or ReplyKeyboardRemove or ForceReply
parameters.description: Additional interface options. A JSON-serialized object for an inline keyboard, custom reply keyboard, instructions to remove a reply keyboard or to force a reply from the user.

description: Use this method to send a message with an HTML widget. Currently, in the production environment, widgets can be sent only to private chats, and sent widgets automatically have protected content and therefore can't be forwarded. On success, the sent Message is returned.
